title: Phase 0 — static runtime, everything frozen
description: The real viewer mounted offline from a hand-written manifest: card, Plotly figure, MultiSelect and text component, all served from frozen payloads with tier badges. No backend, no network.

title: Phase 1 — penguins with LIVE cards and filters
description: Built by producer B from a spec + local Parquet (depictio dashboard build-static). Cards, MultiSelect filters and text are live: change the species or year selection and the card values recompute offline through the in-browser hyparquet engine. The scatter figure stays frozen until phase 5 (bind-and-refill). Regenerate with depictio/serverless/examples/generate_demo_manifest.py.
